title: Cyberpunk Hero Concept Exploration
prompt: Design exploration for a cyberpunk street samurai character. The character is a female mercenary in a neon-lit megacity, with cybernetic arm augmentations and a retractable plasma blade. Explore different armor styles, silhouettes, and color treatments.

style.visual_style: concept art painterly style with loose brushwork

constraints.avoid: anime style, cartoonish proportions, photorealistic rendering
